original.target_description: Study 1: across-participant correlation of ERN amplitude at FCz with error-potentiated startle (error-trial magnitude minus mean of predictable and unpredictable correct-trial magnitudes), full undergraduate sample.

n.exclusions: No participant exclusions reported; no participants discontinued. EEG and EMG artifact exclusions were at trial/channel level. Full sample supported by repeated-measures F(2, 60) and t(30) in the same results section.
n.location: p. 104 (PDF p. 2), Method; p. 105 (PDF p. 3), Results
n.quote: Thirty-one undergraduate students (26 male, 5 female) participated in this study.

es.location: p. 105 (PDF p. 3), Results, right column, paragraph beginning To determine whether

p.location: p. 105 (PDF p. 3), Results, right column, same ERN/startle correlation

replication.target_description: Primary Pearson correlation between ERN amplitude and error-potentiated startle magnitude, replication full analysis sample; not the exploratory median-split subgroup.

n.exclusions: 51 recruited; eight excluded for high electrode impedances or excessive muscle artifacts; reported final overall sample 43. Target-specific analytic n is not explicitly printed; other tests have varying degrees of freedom.
n.location: p. 4, section 3.1 Actual Sample and section 4.2 Statistical results
n.quote: Thus, the final sample included in the analysis was 43 subjects.

es.quote: a correlation between ERN and EPS amplitude, did not reach the threshold for significance in our replication: r = -.25, p = .11, one-tailed.

reported_success.location: p. 7, section 5.1 Summary of Replication Attempt (continued from p. 5)
reported_success.quote: For this reason, we consider this to be a failure to replicate but with extremely similar results.

notes: Original title and authors verified against supplied reference. Original correlation minus sign and equality symbol visually verified in primary PDF p. 105; cached PDF text extraction drops minus signs and renders equals signs as 5. Replication reports final overall sample 43, but target-specific analytic n remains null because no correlation n is printed and other tests have varying degrees of freedom. Primary correlation extracted, excluding exploratory median-split/outlier-removal and combined-sample analyses.
